intro.title: Testing with pytest
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Python function and learn how to test it using the pytest framework. You'll explore the core concept of unit testing, which involves writing small, automated checks to verify that your code works as expected. The main technologies involved are Python functions, the pytest library, and test functions that use assertions. By the end, you'll be able to write, run, and interpret basic tests to ensure your code is reliable and bug-free.
intro.usecase: Testing with pytest is essential for ensuring reliability in real-world applications like e-commerce checkout systems, where payment processing must work flawlessly every time. Developers use pytest to validate API endpoints in banking apps, test data transformations in analytics dashboards, and verify form validations in user registration flows. When building features like search filters or recommendation engines, pytest helps catch edge cases before they reach production. This testing approach gives teams confidence when deploying updates to critical systems like healthcare portals or financial trading platforms.
